data.body:
Two process notes from implementation.

1. This ticket was worked while still `open`. My subagent brief asserted it was already claimed; it was not, and I told the agent not to run tracker writes, so nothing corrected it. Claimed now, retroactively — recording it rather than quietly fixing it, because 'claim before you work' is exactly the discipline that keeps the board honest about who holds what.

2. AC1b as originally written was UNSATISFIABLE and has been corrected. It asked for `'rebar.config' not in sys.modules` after importing `rebar._operation_config`, but `rebar/__init__.py:27` does `from rebar import config`, so that is true on unmodified main as well — verified by running it. The criterion would have been red before and after, pinning the package __init__ rather than this change. It now asserts cache_info() misses at import versus after first call, plus AST assertions that no module-scope import names rebar.config and that the import lives inside the accessor body. A mutation hoisting the import to module scope turns those RED with the circular-import traceback.

Implemented and pushed as Gerrit change 2547 from an isolated worktree, branched from origin/main so it does NOT stack on the six-change stack that is currently Verified -1.
